title: Deadline is not permission
text:
SEC. 1. Fees
Not later than May 1, 2028, the Secretary shall not require applicants to pay a fee of $100.

patterns: ^Prohibits Not later than May 1, 2028, the Secretary from requiring applicants to pay a fee of \$100\.$
